sections.heading: 1. Ease into it
lines: ① Use a thin pillow, or none, under your face.
② Hug a long pillow and lie half on your side.
③ Pop a pillow under your top knee.
④ Morning: slow neck turns, 5 each side.

sections.heading: 2. Get it checked if…
lines: You have arm pain or pins and needles,
or it's not easing after a week or two.

caption:
Waking up with a stiff neck? Sleeping face down could be part of it.

Lying on your stomach means turning your head fully to one side to breathe, and holding that end position for hours can leave some people stiff. A thick pillow adds more twist. If you wake up fine, there's no need to change a thing.

If you're stiff most mornings, try a thin pillow or none under your face, and ease towards side sleeping by hugging a long pillow with one under your top knee.

Arm pain, pins and needles, building headaches or stiffness that isn't easing after a week or two is worth an assessment. Our chiropractors at Hybrid Physio can help. Book online via the link in bio.
